supported_scope: Invalidity of inferring distinct global primes from branches after losing fundamental-group image; not a realized geometric counterexample.

claim_assessments.reason: A transitive two-sheet action has one global orbit, while restriction to the trivial disc group has two; a pi1-surjective core is the missing hypothesis.

retired_because: Dropping loops can split a connected finite cover; local branches then overcount distinct global primes. Preserve surjectivity on pi1 instead.
